The **Plasma Caster** is a heavy gun in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

A powerful energy weapon similar in fire rate and range to the ballistic Gatling Gun. The Plasma Caster deals more damage than other energy weapons but has a low magazine size and fire rate. It can be further upgraded to drain enemy Fusion Cores with each hit.

As with other weapons available only after the main quest line of *Wastelanders*, Plasma Casters cannot be traded, dropped, or sold to vendors.
